title: Speed up launch tests while preserving coverage

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** At `2cc150eae0211a1bd5475a3b6b84e3aaa5591e6a`, the maintained Chromium test caught the omission of the recorded max-effort line when opening Session details. This check covers the recorded execution-session example in `SEED-413#finish-launch-proof-orthogonal`, plan 780 slice 8.

- **Fault and fixture.** In `dashboard/src/SessionDetails.tsx:55`, the scratch fault suppressed the effort paragraph when `record.request.effort` was `"max"`. The test kept the existing “Build at max effort” Claude execution fixture with session ID `max-effort` and `requestingEffort("max")` in `dashboard/frontend-tests/launches/launch-record-details.spec.ts:45`.
- **Reach and wrong behavior.** Independently of the locator verdict, the Playwright DOM snapshot immediately before the effort lookup showed the `max-effort` session’s details expanded and its session ID rendered. The disclosed paragraphs showed the start, local-launch note, and session identity, with the effort line absent. The separate Opus execution and Sonnet ad hoc entries still displayed their requested models. The failure accessibility tree agreed with the snapshot.
- **Maintained assertion.** The only selected test was “execution and ad hoc entries show the requested model and disclose effort only when recorded” at `dashboard/frontend-tests/launches/launch-record-details.spec.ts:144`. After verifying the open disclosure and the session identity, its call at line 156 reached `showsWords` at line 124. The exact-text visibility assertion for `Effort: max (requested)` failed because the locator found no element in that entry.
- **Runs and restoration.** The detached scratch checkout ran `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/launches/launch-record-details.spec.ts --workers=2 --grep 'execution and ad hoc entries show the requested model and disclose effort only when recorded$'` on AC with temporary failure tracing. The baseline passed, the faulted run failed at the named assertion, and the restored run passed the same selected case. The final scratch status matched its clean starting state after removing the tracing setup, and the scratch checkout and artifacts were removed.

**Next proof action.** Retain the maintained assertion for the recorded-effort disclosure path.

**Prior disposition.** The story’s wrap-up decision to accept the measured improvement and carry the remaining 7–8 second target into a follow-up predates this check.

- **Test runtime.** 22.17 s total (measured), from Vitest’s reported durations of 3.17 s baseline, 17.55 s faulted, and 1.45 s restored.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human time record was supplied.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate agent active-time measure was available.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 282002 ms (measured), from 1795410785000 to 1795411067002 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

**Wrap-up disposition.** Checked `2cc150eae0211a1bd5475a3b6b84e3aaa5591e6a`. Caught. Retain the assertion. No follow-up for the proof.
